outgoing.name: Greece
outgoing.excerpt: The natural range of the Marginated Tortoise is southern Greece, from the Peloponnesus to Mount Olympus.

outgoing.name: Italy
outgoing.excerpt: They are also found in isolated zones of the Balkans and Italy, with a somewhat broader range in northeastern Sardinia.

outgoing.name: Soil
outgoing.excerpt: The females lay their hard-shelled spherical eggs in the soil in May and June.

outgoing.name: Summer
